Where the files under lorawan-devices/ come from
================================================

Repository: https://github.com/TheThingsNetwork/lorawan-devices
Commit:     900afb52024f795f073ee4192d845af12d2168d0 (master, committed 2026-10-09)
Fetched:    2026-10-11, file by file from raw.githubusercontent.com at that
            commit; the repository was not cloned.

Paths under lorawan-devices/vendor/ are the upstream paths. Each codec
YAML file is kept with every JavaScript file it names (shared files such as
elsys/elsys.js and decentlab/dl-downlink-codec.js once). The files are
unchanged; makers' copyright headers stay in place.

Vendors and codec files taken (57 codec files, 11 vendors): adeunis 4,
browan 4, decentlab 6, dragino 8, elsys 5, mclimate 4, milesight-iot 8,
netvox 6, sensecap 4, tektelic 4, watteco 4. They were chosen as popular
makers whose codec files carry examples; two sensecap files
(sensecapt1000-tracker-ab, sensecap2120-8-in-1) have no examples and are
only loaded.

Licence: the repository has no LICENSE file at that commit. Its
package.json declares "license": "Apache-2.0" with "author": "The Things
Network Foundation". lorawan-devices/LICENSE here is the Apache License 2.0
text, added by us so the licence travels with the files.

Not used: the repository's device, profile and image files, and its
validator (bin/validate.js, tools/runscript), which the test follows in
spirit only (see ../examples_test.go).
